description: This file implements a browser-friendly Minimax (alpha-beta) chess AI for use with chess.js, including evaluation functions, move ordering, difficulty presets, and principal variation extraction.

methods.name: getDifficultyPreset
methods.description: Returns engine settings (depth, timeBudgetMs, randomness, topK) based on a difficulty string.

methods.name: findBestMove
methods.description: Computes the best move for the given FEN, side, depth, optional time budget, and randomness, using minimax alpha-beta search.

methods.name: getPrincipalVariation
methods.description: Calculates the best line (principal variation) from a given FEN position up to specified depth and time constraints, for analysis.

methods.name: difficultyToDepth
methods.description: Maps difficulty level to a search depth (plies).

methods.name: difficultyToTimeBudgetMs
methods.description: Maps difficulty level to a soft time budget in milliseconds.

methods.name: difficultyToRandomness
methods.description: Maps difficulty level to a randomness probability for move selection.

methods.name: evaluateFen
methods.description: Evaluates a position given by FEN string, returning more detailed static evaluation from the engine.
